novelty_flags.label: related_work; thm:target-ratio-identification
novelty_flags.one_line: Dahabreh et al. (2023) has Theorems 1–4 in Sections 3.3–3.5, not “Theorems 3.3 and 3.4”; the cited theorem anchors must be corrected.

soundness_flags.label: ass:receipt-contrast-transport
soundness_flags.one_line: RudolphVanderLaan2017 does not support the stated cross-source conditional compliance-ITT transport condition: its CACE denominator is a target-site first stage, so retag this as a novel transport assumption and justify it.

soundness_flags.label: ass:strength-floor
soundness_flags.one_line: Mikusheva2010 studies a single-endogenous-regressor IV model and does not define the collection index T_coll or its lower-bound class; label this explicitly as the proposal's adapted strength class rather than a standard cited condition.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The collection-positivity and weaker-overlap results are numbered Theorems 1–4; Section 3.3 contains Theorem 1, Section 3.4 contains Theorems 2–3, and Section 3.5 contains Theorem 4.

Equation (4) defines transported CACE as a transported outcome numerator divided by a non-transported target-site instrument-to-exposure contrast; it does not assume or establish source-to-target transportability of the conditional compliance contrast.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Econometrics 157(2), 2010 version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper concerns confidence sets for the coefficient on a single endogenous regressor in an IV regression and weak-instrument test inversion; it does not define a multi-trial collection concentration index or its induced law class.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct Dahabreh's theorem anchors throughout and state precisely that the proposal uses its Section 3.4 union-support logic while replacing its treatment-effect target by a transported encouragement ratio.
Retag and substantively motivate first-stage/compliance-contrast transport as a novel scientific assumption; distinguish it from Rudolph and van der Laan's target-site first-stage condition.

Make the repository distinction decisive by proving that the support-hypergraph program cannot be reduced to the existing transported-LATE fixed-geometry/Kish formulation, ideally as an explicit strict-separation corollary against that catalogue result.

Add a formal equivalence between the allocation optimum and a pooled observed-data experiment with source-specific propensities, or prove non-equivalence; this resolves whether T_coll is a genuinely new information object rather than a reparameterized transport geometry.

recommended_next_step: Revise the cited-assumption and Dahabreh numbering errors, then sharpen the formal non-subsumption argument versus the in-catalogue transported-LATE strength frontier before advancing to Stage 0.
